_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES topics (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "uri" TEXT NULL, "unit_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_units" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id), "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chunks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id), "parent_chunk_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_unit" INTEGER NULL, "end_unit" INTEGER NULL, "size_units" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chunk_surveys" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chunk_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES chunks (id), "difficulty" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("difficulty" BETWEEN 1 AND 3), "familiarity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("familiarity" BETWEEN 0 AND 2), "surveyed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "topic_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES topics (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "needs_detail" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_detail" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_chunks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "chunk_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id), "start_unit" INTEGER NULL, "end_unit" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_states" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES tasks (id), "level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("level" BETWEEN 0 AND 7), "fsrs_stability" REAL NULL, "fsrs_difficulty" REAL NULL, "last_review_at" INTEGER NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rating" BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "duration_sec" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resume_unit" INTEGER NULL, "level_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stability_after" REAL NOT NULL, "due_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_lineages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "child_task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "parent_task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL, "options" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_results" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cards (id), "review_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews (id), "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "answer_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exams" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("priority" BETWEEN 1 AND 3), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_chunks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exam_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), "chunk_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chunks (id), "importance" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exam_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "importance" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_level" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "importance_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("importance_overridden" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("exam_id", "task_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "availabilities" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 0 AND 6), "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locked_exam_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "availability_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "locked_exam_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "exam_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exams (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "est_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "progress" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "unlocked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rest_tokens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "earned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "used_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_maps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id), "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "active_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resume_unit" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX task_chunks_task ON task_chunks (task_id)
CREATE INDEX reviews_task_at ON reviews (task_id, at)
CREATE INDEX exam_tasks_exam ON exam_tasks (exam_id)
CREATE INDEX plan_items_date ON plan_items (date)
CREATE INDEX events_entity ON events (entity, entity_id)
